observed_result.summary: Relevant behaviour correct, dynamic unknowns stay unknown, unrelated content and newer edits survive, generation deterministic: parser/evaluator corpus against each client's ssh -G, the projection transaction (commit points, recovery, quarantine, Git name transitions), setup admission.

limitations: Build identity: the runs used base commit bcad82de plus the uncommitted wave-5 working tree, bound by the digests in build_commit; the records describe that tree, not a commit. Once it is committed the native runs should be repeated at that commit (ADR-0007 §12.31 item 5).
Status discipline (m02-plan, M01 rule E15): verified rows mean the required tests ran and passed on that platform in this run; not an independent review of the units.

Linux and Windows binaries are cross-built on the macOS host with zig and run natively on the hosts; tests that read the repository at its compile-time path run on the build host only (case-index.json build_host_paths): a platform-neutral one counts as run elsewhere, any other keeps its row in_progress (harness gap). On Linux this leaves every corpus comparison against the host client's ssh -G (integration_sshconf_vs_ssh_g corpus_*, bom_and_crlf_acceptance, include_state_is_restored_after_included_file) unrun.

Two tests read compile-time paths but are not yet in build_host_paths, so they failed on Linux for that reason: heimdall-unit tui::view::tests::the_refusal_is_visible_in_the_modal (snapshot file decision_apply_refused_40x12) and e2e_cli_m02 unix::uninstall_purge_state_is_refused_without_a_typed_yes_and_keeps_everything (schemas/public-api).

The e2e pseudo-terminal cases (e2e_cli_m02 and e2e_run_m02) start their child with a cleared environment, so the child loses HEIMDALL_E2E_BIN and execs the build host's CARGO_BIN_EXE_heimdall path; off the build host they fail with 'exec failed: No such file or directory' (Linux run). A test-harness defect, escalated; those Linux rows stay in_progress.
Proptest regression files resolve at compile-time source paths: persisted regression seeds replay on macOS only; the fixed default seeds run everywhere.

Every fixture is disposable: per-run keys, the loopback fixture sshd, disposable ssh-agents with a scratch HOME, scratch configuration; the owners' keys, agents, ~/.ssh and Git configuration are never test material (m02-plan §0; ADR-0007 §9).

Redaction: the build host's name is three characters long, so the macOS harness's host-name redaction also rewrote parts of ordinary words in macos/ (the os= fact in host.txt and some crate and selftest names read '<host>'); over-redaction only. run-windows.sh stopped before its build-log redaction when the host was unreachable; windows/build.txt was redacted afterwards with the same m02_redact helper (build host home, user, TMPDIR) by M02-W5-run.
blocked_on: B10: Windows Developer Mode on the Windows PC, or one elevation, to create a file symbolic link; the WSL2 disposable distribution on the Windows 11 PC: reached through the same PC endpoint, which was unreachable during the run; also needs HM_WSL_ROOTFS (the pinned image on the PC) or HM_WSL_DOWNLOAD=1; the Windows 11 x64 PC: its WSL ssh endpoint (HM_SSH_CONFIG) did not accept a connection during the run (03:56Z-04:47Z, 22 attempts, connection timed out; the PC itself answered). Needs the owner to bring that endpoint up (WSL running with its sshd on the PC)
